explain.total-region: SUMIFS adds G2:G181 on the rows where D2:D181 is Macedonia: **{{=SUMIFS(G2:G181,D2:D181,"Macedonia")}}**. `SUMIF(D2:D181,"Macedonia",G2:G181)` is equally right.
explain.orders-partner: {{=COUNTIF(F2:F181,"Partner")}} rows in F2:F181 say Partner. SUMIF would add their units ({{=SUMIF(F2:F181,"Partner",G2:G181)}}), which answers a different question.
explain.rep-units: Nikos Petrou has {{=COUNTIF(E2:E181,"Nikos Petrou")}} orders totalling **{{=SUMIFS(G2:G181,E2:E181,"Nikos Petrou")}}** units.
explain.big-orders: `">12"` counts 13 and up: **{{=COUNTIF(G2:G181,">12")}}**. `">=12"` would also count the {{=COUNTIF(G2:G181,12)}} orders of exactly 12.
explain.mouse-not-attica: P004 orders outside Attica total **{{=SUMIFS(G2:G181,C2:C181,"P004",D2:D181,"<>Attica")}}** units; the {{=SUMIFS(G2:G181,C2:C181,"P004",D2:D181,"Attica")}} Attica units are excluded by `"<>Attica"`.
explain.share-25plus: {{=COUNTIF(G2:G181,">=25")}} of the {{=COUNTA(A2:A181)}} orders have 25 or more units: rounded, **{{=ROUND(COUNTIF(G2:G181,">=25")/COUNTA(A2:A181),2)}}**. Using `">25"` drops the {{=COUNTIF(G2:G181,25)}} orders of exactly 25.
explain.rep-target: Maria Ioannou sold {{=SUMIF(E2:E181,"Maria Ioannou",G2:G181)}} units across {{=COUNTIF(E2:E181,"Maria Ioannou")}} orders. {{=SUMIF(E2:E181,"Maria Ioannou",G2:G181)}} ≥ 550, so **{{=IF(SUMIF(E2:E181,"Maria Ioannou",G2:G181)>=550,"Target met","Below target")}}**.
